items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: The name 'Omar' is mentioned by the [INTERVIEWER] ('Here, Omar.') but the [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, nor is Omar mentioned in the interviewee's subsequent narration.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bill Johnson was kind of random. There was men here in the group. Yeah. All the theory, I think.
Yeah. There was a bandit player, I think, since then. Here, Omar. He had a little here, Little Mitch. There was men driving.

A band that, uh, Jolly got together for a tour. And, uh, it had been a band that belonged to a man by the name of Eldin or Eldridge or something like that. Do you remember anything about such a band? It would be in the, maybe in the late 20s. No, 26, 22. What's going on?
